# Current design documentation

- This is a design study, not construction drawings. Consult
  [project guidance](../copilot-instructions.md), the affected room page,
  [plan reference](../../floor-plan-reference.md) and
  [design context](../../design-context.md). The newest explicit owner decision
  supersedes earlier alternatives; repeated older dimensions are not votes.
- With a model change, update the affected room page and both design references
  together. Also correct affected active viewer notes, schedules and takeoffs.
  Documentation-only research does not authorize geometry changes.
- Keep current summaries internally consistent rather than stacking conflicting
  "latest" paragraphs. Retain older alternatives only as labeled history;
  do not delete useful owner requirements while shortening notes.
- Distinguish room envelope, finished-face clearance, nominal product size and
  rough opening. State units, reference faces and whether a value was measured
  in the model or came from a manufacturer. All doors are 96 inches tall.
- Separate modeled fit from occupied operation and professional approval.
  Storage-only and approval-required arrangements need appropriate labels in
  existing viewer notes as well as documentation. Do not create a new banner
  for ordinary explanatory content or auto-open the notes panel.
- Follow [product research](../skills/home-product-research/SKILL.md) for
  product/code claims: exact model, authoritative URL, access date and unresolved
  requirements. Do not turn inspiration photos or texture names into selections.
- Preserve existing HTML page structure, navigation, theme and accessibility.
  Avoid unrelated page restyling; use relative links in repository documents.
